accounts.name: cargoPod

docs: The definition of tracked stats.

fields.name: authority

fields.name: openTokenAccounts

fields.name: podSeeds
docs: The seeds of the signer for this pod.

fields.name: podBump
docs: The bump of the signer for this pod.

fields.name: seqId
docs: The sequence id for the definition

fields.name: unupdatedTokenAccounts
docs: The number of unupdated token accounts in this pod. If this is greater than zero means the pod is frozen and only can withdraw cargo but not deposit.

accounts.name: cargoType

fields.name: version
docs: The data version of this account.

fields.name: statsDefinition
docs: The definition this follows

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint the cargo type is for

fields.name: creator
docs: TODO: remove this

fields.name: bump
docs: The bump for this account

fields.name: statsCount
docs: The number of stats in this definition.

fields.name: seqId
docs: The sequence id for the definition

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

instructions.name: addCargo
docs: Adds cargo to a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod).
Requires the authority to sign.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signerOriginAccount} adds ${data.cargoAmount} of cargo type ${accounts.cargoType} from ${accounts.originTokenAccount} to cargo pod ${accounts.cargoPod}

instructions.name: closeCargoPod
docs: Closes the [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod) if it has no open token accounts.
Requires the authority to sign.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} closes cargo pod ${accounts.cargoPod} and returns its rent to ${accounts.funder}

instructions.name: closeTokenAccount
docs: Closes and burns any excess tokens in a given token account within a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod).
Requires the authority to sign.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} closes token account ${accounts.cargoTokenAccount} for ${accounts.mint} in cargo pod ${accounts.cargoPod}, burning any tokens left in it, and returns its rent to ${accounts.funder}

instructions.name: consumeCargo
docs: Consumes cargo from a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod), burning the amount.
Requires the authority to sign.

instructions.name: initCargoPod
docs: Inits a new [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod) account for the given [`CargoStatsDefinition`](state::CargoStatsDefinition) and authority.

instructions.name: initCargoType
docs: Inits a new [`CargoType`](state::CargoType) account for the given [`CargoStatsDefinition`](state::CargoStatsDefinition).

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.key} registers ${accounts.mint} as cargo type ${accounts.cargoType} of cargo stats definition ${accounts.statsDefinition}

instructions.name: initCargoTypeForNextSeqId
docs: Creates a new cargo type for the next `seq_id`.

display.intent: Register a cargo type for the next version
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.key} registers ${accounts.mint} as cargo type ${accounts.cargoType} for the next version of cargo stats definition ${accounts.statsDefinition}

instructions.name: initCargoTypeFromOldCargoType
docs: Creates a new cargo type for the next `seq_id` from a given cargo type.

display.intent: Copy a cargo type to the next version
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.key} creates cargo type ${accounts.cargoType} for the next version of cargo stats definition ${accounts.statsDefinition} from cargo type ${accounts.oldCargoType}

instructions.name: initDefinition
docs: Inits a [`CargoStatsDefinition`](state::CargoStatsDefinition) account.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.funder} creates cargo stats definition ${accounts.statsDefinition}, tracking ${data.input.cargoStats} stats, for cargo permissions profile ${accounts.profile}

instructions.name: legitimizeCargo
docs: Legitimizes cargo in a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod) that was added outside of [`add_cargo`] or other cargo ix.
Requires the authority to sign.

display.intent: Record cargo sent to a pod
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} records ${data.cargoAmount} of cargo type ${accounts.cargoType} sent straight to ${accounts.cargoTokenAccount} as cargo of pod ${accounts.cargoPod}

instructions.name: mintTo
docs: Mints tokens directly to a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod).
Requires the authority to sign.

instructions.name: removeCargo
docs: Removes cargo from a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod) to a given token account.
Requires the authority to sign.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} removes ${data.cargoAmount} of cargo type ${accounts.cargoType} from cargo pod ${accounts.cargoPod} to ${accounts.destinationTokenAccount}

instructions.name: transferAuthority
docs: Transfers authority of a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod) to a new authority.
Requires both authorities to sign.

instructions.name: transferCargo
docs: Transfers cargo between [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod)s.
Requires both authorities to sign.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.originPodAuthority} moves ${data.cargoAmount} of cargo type ${accounts.cargoType} from cargo pod ${accounts.originCargoPod} to cargo pod ${accounts.destinationCargoPod}

instructions.name: updateCargoPod
docs: Updates a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod) account to have the newest sequence id from the [`CargoDefinition`](state::CargoStatsDefinition).
This is the first step to update a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod) to a new [`CargoStatsDefinition`](state::CargoStatsDefinition).
Permissionless function.

display.interpolatedIntent: Cargo pod ${accounts.cargoPod} moves to the latest version of cargo stats definition ${accounts.statsDefinition}

instructions.name: updateDefinition
docs: Updates a [`CargoStatsDefinition`](state::CargoStatsDefinition) account.
Will advance the `seq_id` unless `rollback` is set to true.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.key} updates cargo stats definition ${accounts.statsDefinition} of cargo permissions profile ${accounts.profile}

instructions.name: updatePodTokenAccount
docs: Updates a [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod)'s token account to have the same sequence id as the [`CargoPod`](state::CargoPod).
This must be called after [`update_cargo_pod`].
Permissionless function.

display.intent: Update a pod token account's version
display.interpolatedIntent: Token account ${accounts.cargoTokenAccount} of cargo pod ${accounts.cargoPod} moves from cargo type ${accounts.oldCargoType} to cargo type ${accounts.cargoType}
